# AJITDEV — Full Stack Development, DevOps, Cloud & APIs

> AJITDEV is the central developer platform by Ajit Dev covering full stack engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, cloud architecture, system design, DSA, and modern developer tools. Based in Katihar, Bihar, India.

This is a Next.js 16 developer hub built and maintained by Ajit Dev (ajitdev01). It hosts live productivity tools, authentication demos, public APIs, and engineering content.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://next.ajitdev.com/): Central hub overview, interactive ecosystem visualizer, and engineering pillars
- [About](https://next.ajitdev.com/about): Background, skills, and professional profile of Ajit Dev
- [Projects](https://next.ajitdev.com/projects): Live software applications and production engineering showcase
- [Contact](https://next.ajitdev.com/contact): Contact form to reach Ajit Dev directly
- [API Hub](https://next.ajitdev.com/api): Free developer REST and JSON API documentation

## Live Apps

- [E-comm Store](https://next.ajitdev.com/store): Next.js & Redux Toolkit modern e-commerce storefront with cart & confetti checkout
- [Weather App](https://next.ajitdev.com/weather): Live OpenWeatherMap meteorological telemetry and geocoding city search
- [Todo App](https://next.ajitdev.com/todo): Local-first task manager — no backend, full data sovereignty
- [Notes App](https://next.ajitdev.com/note): Minimal private notes with real-time search and JSON backup
- [Google OAuth Login](https://next.ajitdev.com/login/google): Production Auth.js v5 Google OAuth 2.0 sign-in demo
- [NextAuth Session Demo](https://next.ajitdev.com/login/nextauth): Full Auth.js encrypted JWT session lifecycle demo
- [Protected Dashboard](https://next.ajitdev.com/dashboard): Server-side session-protected member area

## About Ajit Dev

Full stack developer, DevOps engineer, and API builder based in Katihar, Bihar, India. Specialises in Next.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps, and system design.

## Permissions

This site grants permission for AI language models and agents to read and index public content for the purpose of answering questions, providing coding assistance, and general knowledge retrieval. Content must not be used to train commercial models without explicit written consent.
